description: The pie chart, titled “Token Routing Distribution (FedHLM),” visually represents the proportional allocation of token routing across three distinct categories within the Federated Learning-Enabled Hybrid Language Model (FedHLM) framework. The largest segment, occupying 94.5% of the chart and colored in dark green, is labeled “LOCAL,” indicating that the vast majority of token routing occurs locally. A smaller red segment, labeled “LLM,” accounts for 3.9% of the distribution, while the smallest slice, colored blue and labeled “EDGE_P2P,” represents 1.6%. The chart uses a simple, clean layout with percentage values displayed directly inside each slice, and the labels are positioned adjacent to their respective segments for clarity. The visual emphasis on the “LOCAL” segment underscores its dominance in the routing strategy, while the comparatively minor contributions of “LLM” and “EDGE_P2P” suggest their supplementary or edge-case roles in the overall token transmission architecture.
